title: Cloud Security: independent resource scopes
content:
Cloud Security handling of independent resource scopes is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

Multiple independent resource scopes may be held.

Use external reference as the signed resource-scope key.

Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed the maximum of 24 nonclosed contracts per customer.

A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable open action, authoritative system records must establish: The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference, customer reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a repeated signed scope open another contract?**

A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

## Duplicate signed scope

Hypothetical case: the customer submits the same signed application for a resource scope already represented by an existing contract. Reuse that contract; this submission does not open another.
